اشترطن (form VIII)
# اِشْتَرَطْنَ (ištaraṭna) /iʃ.ta.ratˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# اُشْتُرِطْنَ (ušturiṭna) /uʃ.tu.ritˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# اِشْتَرِطْنَ (ištariṭna) /iʃ.ta.ritˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
